result.title: Exists, Valid: Calibrated Validity of Stored 3D Geometry Across Long Observation Gaps
result.summary: Repeated airborne LiDAR surveys are costly, while stored 3D geometry can become outdated between observations. Existing change-detection methods compare observed epochs. However, they do not quantify the validity of geometry that has not been revisited. We distinguish observation, existence and geometric validity using a probabilistic filter over five geometric transitions: persistence, modification, growth, removal and replacement. The framework learns class-specific continuous-time transition priors from interval-censored observations and combines shape residuals with LiDAR free-space evidence. Functional anchors enable prior sharing across sites with different survey frequencies. In controlled experiments with misspecified dynamics and 60% visibility, our method reduces combined error from 36.9% to 16.5% and expected calibration error (ECE) from 0.19-0.32 to 0.017. Cross-site sharing reduces ECE at two-survey sites from 0.156 to 0.029. On Urb3DCD-v2, the method achieves 9.8% combined error and 0.016 ECE, outperforming baselines at 12.6% and at least 0.070, respectively. Re-survey prioritisation improves only modestly over random selection with two observations. Code and an evaluation protocol are released at https://github.com/anwaarua/life4d.

AI.brief_summary: 将「被观测过」「仍然存在」与「几何仍然有效」区分开，用覆盖持续、修改、生长、移除、替换五类转移的概率滤波，结合形状残差与 LiDAR 自由空间证据，对长期未重访的存储 3D 几何给出校准后的有效性判断，并用于重测优先级排序。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作把「状态是否仍然有效」与「是否被观测」解耦并做校准，可能为 LVR 中 latent 是否仍由当前视觉证据支撑、何时需重新 LOOK 或 STOP 提供问题表述与评价思路，尚需核查其转移先验与主动重观测策略的可迁移性。
